description: This file contains a Perl script that generates ARM assembly code for SHA-512 hash computation optimized for ARMv4 architecture, including NEON optimizations. It includes licensing info, platform-specific optimizations, and assembly routines for SHA-512 processing.

methods.name: BODY_00_15
methods.description: Generates ARM assembly code for SHA-512 processing steps for rounds 0-15, including sigma functions and message schedule updates.

methods.name: NEON_00_15
methods.description: Generates NEON-optimized assembly code for SHA-512 rounds 0-15, utilizing vector instructions for performance.

methods.name: NEON_16_79
methods.description: Generates NEON-optimized assembly code for rounds 16-79, processing two rounds per iteration for efficiency.
